scenes.title: A million items
scenes.purpose: Make the scale of a linear scan felt
scenes.visual: A field of 160 bars standing for 1,000,000 sorted items; a marker sweeps left to right, accelerating, and reaches the target exactly as the scene cuts

transition_out.continuity: the marker is moving fast when the cut lands

scenes.title: Halving
scenes.purpose: Show that each check discards half
scenes.visual: The same field; each check collapses the half without the target and the camera follows what remains, counting 500,000 down to 62,500

transition_out.continuity: the remaining target bar becomes the large bar in the next scene

scenes.title: Twenty
scenes.visual: A giant 20 arrives from oversize, twenty ticks fill, the formula appears small, and the piece ends quieter
